name: SSD1306 0.96 inch OLED display, 128x64, I2C (4-pin)
description: Small monochrome OLED on I2C (address 0x3C), common 4-pin module.
notes: PIN ORDER VARIES: most are GND-VCC-SCL-SDA, but many are VCC-GND-SCL-SDA. Swapping VCC and GND kills it. Read your silkscreen and override the pin positions if needed.
Address 0x3C (some 0x3D, selected by a resistor on the back).
Pull-ups on the module go to VCC (4.7-10 kOhm, varies). On a 3.3 V bus power it from 3.3 V so it does not pull SDA/SCL to 5 V.
Draws about 10-30 mA depending on how many pixels are lit.

pins.name: VCC
pins.label: VCC
pins.note: Board has a 3.3 V regulator (662K) and charge pump: 3.3-5 V in.

keepout.note: glass display, fragile: no screws or pressure on it

geometry.note: Active area about 21.7 x 10.9 mm. Some modules are 26 x 26 mm.
